title: What's the First Song You Remember?
content:
In a recent MetaTalk thread titled "Earliest musical memory?", members are sharing their first memories of music, prompted by a WBUR radio segment featuring music historian George Hewitt, who recalls Patsy Cline as his earliest musical memory.

Come join in as people share personal anecdotes on the many ways that music has touched their lives from an early age!
author: Brandon Blatcher
